acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: The Amsterdam Fire Department has a very surprising sensitivity training video called “The Incident with the Helmet."

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: A strongman gets hired to take over the Amsterdam Fire Department. He’s a career police officer named Leen Schaap who has zero firefighting experience. That does not go over so well. Joanna Kakissis reports the story.
acts.title: A Policeman Burns Down the Firehouse

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A teenage girl decides the only way forward is to tear something down and rebuild from the ground up. Elna Baker explains. A version of this story appears on getmortified.com
acts.title: Mom. Hey Mom. MOM. Hey Mom. Mom. Mom
